chapter: Chicago, Lee Collins and the road
title: The fifty-dollar Bangkok hat and biding your time in music
summary: Danny shows off a straw hat bought on impulse and ties it to waiting your time in closed family bands like Piron's.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So, like right now, I... My wife said, "You bought that (?) and you ain't wearing 'em. I said, "I wore it and I bought it and I'm going into the closet to look at it." I'll look at it, that's what I want, and I can go and buy it. I bought a hat last week for forty dollars, fifty dollars -- $49-something. It's a bad cut, the finest grain straw you can get. It's a beautiful hat. I saw it and I bought it at Weinstein. You don't go into Weinstein unless you got some money in your pocket. And I bought that hat. And if I wait until September, I can get the hat maybe for thirty dollars. But I wanted it then. Because I've got this fifty-dollar hat. And I know what you're doing... I went down to Weinstein's(?) and went and got the hat. The box is even different. It's an elongated box, and it's a... You'll seen the hat.
I've got to see that hat, Danny.
Yeah. Maybe you'll get you one when you're here.
And she... She showed it to the neighbors. And the grain of the hat is knitted so fine that it's remarkable, and you can see its class...
Is that like a Palm Beach? What we used to call a Palm Beach?

Yeah, but it's finer than a Palm Beach. It's a Bangkok. My Dad had one. A Palm Beach is just white, white straw like. But this is a silk straw, like shiny. Very small! Very-very-very-very small. I gave (?) a Panama. So... Well, you get what you want.

So when you're playing music, you wait your time. You know, you say, well, you bide your time. Because here in New Orleans they had bands, and it was impossible for you to get in one of them bands. It was a family band. Piron's band, I mentioned that before -- it was impossible for you to get in that band. And you want to advance when you're playing music.
